recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no core source change is needed unless a future work-group decision reopens _query deprecation.
issue_request: FHIR-19645 asked to deprecate _query as subsumed by custom operations, but the final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution kept _query and required clarifying base/type-only context, search Bundle output, search mechanisms such as paging, _sort, _include, and _revinclude, and input-parameter searchType constraints.
initial_application: The earlier deprecation resolution was reopened in 2022. Historical commit 0d3162cfbb9fbd27bc071508bdde6ed46a182f92 applied the retained-_query direction together with FHIR-28110 by adding OperationDefinition query constraints and revising search.html named-query guidance.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2022-08-08 record the FHIR-19645 decision together with FHIR-28110 and FHIR-34406. Related FHIR-28110 was audited in this worker, and FHIR-34406, FHIR-31491, FHIR-39316, and FHIR-39318 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because Search and OperationDefinition source already retain _query and include the requested constraints and search-interaction guidance.
